text.arabic_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative that resumes a settled prior matter and opens it for causal explanation
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) does not begin from zero. It points back to the prior settled claim in 22:60, keeps that referent conceptually complete, and then lets the night-day and attribute clauses explain why that reality stands.

topics.headline: backward demonstrative hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah explains the prior settled claim in 22:60 rather than starting a detached cosmic statement.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is definite and distal, and the attachment evidence treats it as an anaphoric discourse reference.

topics.headline: demonstrative takes causal predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the following causal complex as the predicate that answers the opening pointer.
topics.reason: Local syntax identifies the causal complement as the predicate of the demonstrative statement.

words.gloss_range: fused causal complementizer, because-that, governing a full asserted clause as the reason

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: assertive complementizer coordinated later in the ayah

words.prose: {{ar:بِأَنَّ}} ({{tr:bi-ʾanna}}) compresses cause and assertion into one opening. The night-day proposition is not a loose aside or an instrument; it becomes the governed reason that answers the demonstrative and carries the prior promise in 22:60 into a causal register of cosmic governance.

topics.headline: causal fact as governed ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a whole asserted proposition functions as the reason for the opening pointer.
topics.reason: The bāʾ is causal and governs an asserted ʾanna-clause, not a simple noun or an instrumental phrase.

topics.headline: boundary turns into explanation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah pivot from the backward pointer into a causal explanation of the prior promise in 22:60.
topics.reason: The compound follows the demonstrative and opens the first causal beat of the explanatory frame.

words.gloss_range: unique divine proper name, accusative under ʾanna while remaining the named agent of the cosmic verb
words.root_gloss_range: proper-name field tied to divinity, worshipful orientation, and need; local form functions as the unique divine name rather than a generic deity noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: causative insertion verb governed by the named agent
second occurrence of the same divine proper name

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) names the agent before the cosmic action begins. Its accusative case comes from the causal ʾanna-frame, but semantically the named God remains the one causing the night-day insertion; with orientation and need pressure still around the name, the cycle is not left to an anonymous cosmic force. The name also prepares the later shift from action to attribute.

topics.headline: proper name as governed agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that causality subordinates the clause grammatically without weakening the named divine agency.
topics.reason: The noun is the accusative ism of ʾanna and the explicit subject of the causative verb.

topics.headline: derivational orientation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the named agent is not an anonymous cosmic force but the ultimate point of orientation and need.
topics.reason: The local reading remains the proper divine name; the derivational dispute can add orientation pressure without replacing the name with a separate lexical sense.

topics.headline: divine name structures action and attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from the same named God as cosmic actor to the same named God as bearer of perception attributes.
topics.reason: The name appears at word 3 before the verbal predicate and at word 15 before the nominal attribute pair.

topics.headline: broad corpus co-occurrence without local payoff
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The row is too broad to add a distinct reader-facing payoff beyond the retained divine-agency topics.
topics.reason: The row gives broad high-frequency co-occurrences for the divine name, but the retained topics already carry the local agency and attribute structure.

words.gloss_range: ongoing Form IV causative insertion, making night enter day within an object-plus-goal frame
words.root_gloss_range: entry into an interior, recess, or access point; local Form IV selects causative making-enter rather than simple entering

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the moved night phase in the first clause
the goal phrase into day
repeated causative insertion verb

words.prose: {{ar:يُولِجُ}} ({{tr:yūliju}}) selects an ongoing causative act: God makes night enter day. The object-plus-goal frame keeps the moved phase separate from the receiving domain, while the root image is entry into an interior rather than simple replacement. Its recurrence in the night-day formula (3:27, 31:29, 35:13, 57:6) and its reprise at word 9 make the clause both formulaic and locally chiastic; even its recited shape tightens into the insertion phrase.

topics.headline: ongoing Form IV causation by God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the cycle as continuous governed causation, not as a self-moving natural process.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect indicative Form IV with the named divine subject.

topics.headline: moved object enters an interior goal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader pictures night penetrating the day-domain, not merely alternating after it.
topics.reason: The verb takes an explicit object and an fī-goal, and the root evidence supports interior entry.

topics.headline: recurring night-into-day formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase as part of a recognized Quranic cosmic formula, not a one-off description.
topics.reason: The supplied recurrence rows list the same night-into-day expression at 3:27, 31:29, 35:13, and 57:6.

topics.headline: first verb sets the mirrored action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first verb prepare the second half where the same action returns with reversed participants.
topics.reason: The same verb recurs at word 9 with night and day reversed.

topics.headline: compact sound of entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can notice the recited shape tightening into the insertion phrase.
topics.reason: The sound row describes a local phonetic texture tied to this word and its immediate phrase.

words.gloss_range: the known night phase as direct object, a temporal condition being inserted rather than an unspecified darkness substance
words.root_gloss_range: night, nocturnal phase, and darkness as absence of solar light; local noun is the definite abstract phase, not an adverbial time marker

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: day as the receiving domain in the first clause
night returning as final goal in reversed role

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّيْلَ}} ({{tr:al-layla}}) is the recognizable night phase made object of the first insertion. It is not just a time adverb or a lump of darkness; it is the dark phase being caused to enter its opposite. Because the same root returns as {{ar:ٱلَّيْلِ}} ({{tr:al-layli}}) at the end, night begins the ABBA sequence as object and closes it as destination.

topics.headline: definite night as moved phase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices night as the known cosmic phase being moved in the first half.
topics.reason: The noun is definite singular and accusative as direct object of the causative verb.

topics.headline: night as phase and absence condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the insertion as a phase transition, not as a physical object being placed somewhere.
topics.reason: Dictionary evidence supports night as a nocturnal phase and darkness, while local grammar treats it as an object of insertion.

topics.headline: night enters its lexical opposite
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah animates a familiar night-day pair by making one opposite enter the other.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence marks night and day as a dominant pair, and the local verb turns the pair into reciprocal movement.

topics.headline: night opens the ABBA reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that night is both first object and final goal, so syntax performs the cycle it describes.
topics.reason: Word 5 begins layl-nahār-nahār-layl, and word 12 returns the same root in a reversed syntactic role.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking directional containment, into, as the goal relation after the insertion verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: insertion verb that licenses directional containment
genitive destination governed by the preposition

words.prose: After the insertion verb, {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) is not a static “in.” It marks day as the interior goal into which night is caused to enter, and it closes the first verbal unit before the mirror clause begins.

topics.headline: into as containment plus goal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices day as a receiving interior, not merely the time during which night occurs.
topics.reason: The preposition follows a verb of insertion and governs the genitive day noun as goal.

topics.headline: compact prepositional closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first insertion clause closing cleanly before the coordinated reversal.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is bound directly to the verb and completes the first verbal clause.

words.gloss_range: the known day phase as genitive goal, the receiving light-domain in the first insertion
words.root_gloss_range: daylight, bright daytime, and related river-flow or spreading imagery; local form selects the temporal day branch while retaining cautious flow pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition governing day as destination
same day root returning as object
night phase entering day

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:al-nahāri}}) is day as the receiving domain, marked genitive after {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}). The root’s river and spreading-light pressure makes the day-domain feel like a field into which night can enter, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as daytime, not river. The short {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) flowing into this noun also lets the preposition-destination dependency be heard. Its later accusative return as {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارَ}} ({{tr:al-nahāra}}) turns that receiving domain into the moved phase.

topics.headline: day as fī-goal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that case makes day the receiving domain before it later becomes the moved object.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under fī and definite singular as the known light phase.

topics.headline: river-flow pressure on daytime
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels daylight as a spreading field, while the local noun remains day rather than river.
topics.reason: The root has river-flow and daytime branches; local form and context select daytime, with flow imagery retained only as lexical pressure.

topics.headline: day prepares ABBA reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first day occurrence is not repeated casually; it is positioned to reverse roles at word 10.
topics.reason: The same root occurs first as genitive destination and later as accusative object in the mirrored clause.

topics.headline: audible fī-to-day binding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the tight dependency between the preposition and its destination.
topics.reason: The phonetic row ties the local sound sequence to the grammatical dependency.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that joins the mirrored insertion clause to the first one

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second finite verb coordinated with the first

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns the completed first insertion into one half of a balanced pair. The following finite verb makes the connector coordination, not accompaniment, so the two opposed movements remain distinct and parallel.

topics.headline: waw coordinates the reversal clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second movement as a coordinated counterpart, not as a subordinate afterthought.
topics.reason: The conjunction links a second finite yūliju clause to the first completed insertion clause.

words.gloss_range: second ongoing Form IV causative insertion, sharing the first subject while reversing object and goal
words.root_gloss_range: entry into an interior with causative Form IV force; local repetition applies the same making-enter action in the reverse direction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: carried subject of the second verb
moved day phase in the second clause
night as receiving destination

words.prose: The second {{ar:يُولِجُ}} ({{tr:yūliju}}) compresses the subject, but it does not change the agent: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) remains understood. The same causative frame repeats with the participants reversed, so the ayah makes the reversal audible and structurally imaginable after the prior promised reversal (22:60).

topics.headline: same agent, repeated frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices compression without agent-shift: the same God causes the reverse insertion.
topics.reason: The second verb omits a repeated overt subject but keeps the same object-plus-fī-goal frame.

topics.headline: interior-entry image in reverse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices day itself becoming the entering phase, under the same causative morphology.
topics.reason: The same Form IV verb applies the interior-entry image to the reversed day-into-night movement.

topics.headline: repeated verb completes reversal pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated verb as the hinge that turns cosmic reciprocity into a proof of reversal.
topics.reason: The exact verb reprise holds the action stable while night and day exchange roles, and the boundary row links this pattern to 22:60.

words.gloss_range: the known day phase as accusative object, the light phase now being moved into night
words.root_gloss_range: daylight and bright daytime, with cautious flow/spreading pressure from the root; local form selects the temporal day branch

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: same day root earlier as genitive destination
night as destination in the second clause

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارَ}} ({{tr:al-nahāra}}) is the same known day phase, but its case has changed. It now stands as the moved object, so the light-flow phase that received night in the first half is carried into night in the second. As the third ABBA slot, it is where the mirrored return begins.

topics.headline: accusative day after role shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same day phase changes grammatical role without changing identity.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the direct object of the second causative verb.

topics.headline: flowing daylight becomes object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the inserted object as a spreading light phase, while the local word still means day.
topics.reason: Root-family flow pressure is retained as imagery, but the local form and context select daytime rather than river.

topics.headline: day completes its role reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices word 10 as the third ABBA slot where the mirrored return begins.
topics.reason: The day root moves from genitive destination at word 7 to accusative object at word 10.

words.gloss_range: second goal preposition, preserving the same directional-containment relation in the reversed clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second insertion verb
genitive night destination governed by the preposition
first matching goal preposition

words.prose: The second {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) gives night the same container status that day had in the first half. The relation is preserved while the participants reverse, so the grammar itself balances the two insertions.

topics.headline: same ingress relation under reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reversal keeps the same into-relation rather than changing the type of motion.
topics.reason: The preposition attaches to the second verb and governs night as the goal, mirroring word 6.

words.gloss_range: the known night phase as genitive goal, the final receiving domain of the reversed insertion
words.root_gloss_range: night, nocturnal absence of solar light, and the dark phase; local form is the definite abstract phase now governed as destination

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: same night root earlier as object
day as object entering night

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّيْلِ}} ({{tr:al-layli}}) closes the cycle by returning the opening night word in a new case and role. The phase that first entered day is now the domain into which day enters, completing the four-term night-day-day-night turn.

topics.headline: genitive night receives day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the dark phase becoming the receiving domain rather than only the thing moved.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the second fī and contrasts with the earlier accusative night.

topics.headline: final night closes the chiasm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word of the cycle turning the syntax back to its starting phase.
topics.reason: The same root appears as opening object and final goal, completing the two-way antithesis.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that adds the attribute ʾanna-clause as a second explanatory ground

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second asserted clause coordinated with the first causal frame
first causal complementizer whose frame carries forward

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does more than append a closing praise. It coordinates the attribute clause with the cosmic-action clause, so hearing and seeing become a second ground for the opening demonstrative within the same explanatory frame.

topics.headline: waw joins two explanatory grounds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final attributes as co-grounded explanation, not as a detached comment on the night-day cycle.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the second ʾanna-clause to the first causal ʾanna-clause.

words.gloss_range: assertive complementizer nominalizing the final divine-attribute clause as a parallel fact

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: subject governed by the second complementizer
predicate pair made into an asserted fact

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾanna}}) turns the final attribute pair into an asserted noun-clause. Because it is coordinated with the earlier causal frame, the ayah pivots from cosmic action to divine perception without leaving explanation; it also continues the attribute-coda movement from the mercy coda in 22:60 into a perceptual register.

topics.headline: attribute pair as asserted fact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hearing and seeing as factual explanatory ground, not a loose devotional aside.
topics.reason: The complementizer governs the divine name and takes the two nominative predicates as the factual clause.

topics.headline: second ʾanna pivots registers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah shifting from verbal governance and the mercy coda in 22:60 to nominal divine perception inside one architecture.
topics.reason: The repeated ʾanna-frame moves from the yūliju predicate to the samīʿun baṣīrun predicate, with the boundary row tying the coda to 22:60.

words.gloss_range: repeated divine proper name, accusative under the second ʾanna and explicitly anchoring the attribute predicates
words.root_gloss_range: proper-name field tied to divinity and worshipful orientation; local use repeats the unique divine name as subject of the attribute coda

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first occurrence as agent of cosmic action
attribute predicates anchored to the repeated name

words.prose: The second {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) restarts the predication instead of leaving the attributes grammatically parasitic on the earlier subject. The same named God who caused the night-day cycle is now explicitly the one described as hearing and seeing, so the name’s orientation pressure carries into the perceptual coda.

topics.headline: repeated name anchors the coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the attribute pair belongs to the same named God, not to an abstract cosmic order.
topics.reason: The divine name is repeated before the attribute predicates and functions as the ism of the second ʾanna.

topics.headline: same ʾanna role, different predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same grammatical role carrying a new predicate type, from action to attribute.
topics.reason: Both divine-name occurrences are accusative under ʾanna, but the first takes a verbal predicate and the second takes nominal attributes.

topics.headline: derivational pressure returns in attribute coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the coda still naming the ultimate point of orientation while hearing and seeing are predicated of Him.
topics.reason: The local use remains the proper divine name; derivational dispute adds orientation pressure without changing the selected proper-name reading.

words.gloss_range: first nominative predicate in the final pair, presenting comprehensive hearing and responsive receptivity as a stable divine quality
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, listening, accepting, and responding; local faʿīl predicate gives stable comprehensive receptivity rather than a momentary hearing event

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: subject of the predicate
paired seeing predicate

words.prose: {{ar:سَمِيعٌۢ}} ({{tr:samīʿun}}) begins the final attribute seal as a nominative predicate of {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}). Its faʿīl form presents a stable, comprehensive hearing quality, and the root-family pressure reaches beyond bare audition into receptive response. Paired with {{ar:بَصِيرٌۭ}} ({{tr:baṣīrun}}), it joins a recurring perceptual dyad that also closes later at 22:75 and contrasts with failed human sight at 22:46; after the mercy coda of 22:60, this word opens the new coda as perceptual grasp.

topics.headline: nominative faʿīl predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hearing as a stable divine quality in the clause, not a new finite event.
topics.reason: The word is nominative khabar of ʾanna and has the faʿīl intensive adjective pattern.

topics.headline: hearing as receptive response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the attribute as complete receptivity to what is heard, not passive sound detection.
topics.reason: The root-family includes hearing, deliberate listening, acceptance, and response; local form selects the divine adjective, not every derivative as a separate sense.

topics.headline: hearing-seeing formula after cosmic action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah closing cosmic control with divine perceptual capacity in a recognized formula.
topics.reason: The rows identify the samīʿun baṣīrun pair across Quranic usage, its 22:75 recurrence, its contrast with 22:46, and its position after the night-day clauses.

topics.headline: auditory-to-visual sound progression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the pair move from softer auditory sounds toward the sharper visual predicate.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows tie the local sound progression to the hearing-to-seeing order.

words.gloss_range: second nominative predicate in the final pair, comprehensive seeing that includes sight, discernment, and evidentiary perception
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, insight, discernment, and evidence; local faʿīl predicate gives stable comprehensive perception, sharpened by the preceding light-dark cycle

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: paired hearing predicate
subject of both predicates

words.prose: {{ar:بَصِيرٌۭ}} ({{tr:baṣīrun}}) lands as the final word and the second predicate of the same subject. With no conjunction between the two predicates, {{ar:سَمِيعٌۢ}} ({{tr:samīʿun}}) and {{ar:بَصِيرٌۭ}} ({{tr:baṣīrun}}) form one compact perceptual unit. The root range reaches from sight into insight and evidence, and the visual attribute is locally sharpened because the ayah has just described control over light and darkness. After the moral-record mercy coda of 22:60, the final word moves the coda to perceived reality.

topics.headline: second predicate in one attribute unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two final adjectives as a single compact predicate pair for one subject.
topics.reason: The second adjective is nominative, shares the subject, and is juxtaposed without an intervening conjunction.

topics.headline: sight broadens into discernment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing perception as discernment and evidentiary seeing, not optical sight alone.
topics.reason: The root-family supports sight, insight, and evidence; local form selects the divine adjective while preserving that perceptual breadth.

topics.headline: seeing sharpened by controlled light phase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices why a seeing attribute fits after the night-day cycle: the One who controls light is described as seeing.
topics.reason: The rows link the visual predicate to the preceding control of day and night without making the root mean light-control itself.

topics.headline: final word seals the formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah landing on comprehensive perception as its last interpretive pressure.
topics.reason: The rows identify the hearing-seeing co-occurrence, the same-surah recurrence at 22:75, and the final-word closure after cosmic alternation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated causative يُولِجُ at words 4 and 8 forms a reversal: night enters day, then day enters night.
baseline_models.mechanism: Each opposite is both container and contained. The chiasm therefore describes governed transfer across a permeable boundary, not instantaneous replacement or the destruction of one phase by the other.

activation_trace.role: Literal entry into another interior supplies the reciprocal transfer mechanism enacted by the two causatives.
Night as the dark contrary of day supplies one pole that is nevertheless made to enter its contrary.
Day as opened daylight supplies the other pole and makes the reversal a transfer between genuine contraries.

changed_reading.before: Night ends and day replaces it, then day ends and night replaces it.
changed_reading.after: Each phase is actively inserted into the other, so transition is reciprocal, gradual, and continuously governed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ingress verb and the day-root's river and widening branches allow the temporal boundary to behave like a moving fluid interface.
baseline_models.mechanism: The non-dominant ل ج ج mapping contributes sea-depth and wave motion while ن ه ر contributes a cut channel and widening flow. Together they model day and night as coupled currents whose volumes expand by entering one another.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior supplies transfer between the two phase-reservoirs.
The split root's sea-depth and wave image supplies turbulent, volumetric movement rather than a hard switch.
A river cutting earth with abundant running water turns النهار into a latent channel as well as daylight.
Opening and widening until flow is possible assigns dilation to the gaining phase.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a clock-like alternation of two fixed blocks.
changed_reading.after: The two phases flow into and dilate one another like coupled waters, preserving a mixed and mobile boundary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ closes the ingress clauses with two distinct modes of apprehension.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hearing reaches what is voiced or hidden from sight, while seeing includes both ocular evidence and inward discernment. Their pairing makes the alternation an attended operation and not merely an unattended natural regularity.

activation_trace.role: Auditory apprehension supplies access to voiced events that the light-dark spectacle alone cannot display.
Hearing as understanding and response makes perception operational rather than passive reception.
Ocular sight supplies direct apprehension of the visible alternation.
Heart-insight extends sight from visible phases to knowledge of their ordering and consequences.

changed_reading.before: Hearing and Seeing are generic epithets appended to a cosmic sign.
changed_reading.after: The two epithets complete the mechanism as complementary channels of attentive knowledge, including both displayed transition and hidden event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence sets equivalent response against renewed transgression, promises redress, and retains pardon. The reciprocal but bounded ingress of opposites then becomes a cosmic analogue for correction without uncontrolled escalation; hearing and seeing make that correction evidence-sensitive.

activation_trace.role: Balanced entry in both directions supplies a non-annihilating model of reciprocal adjustment.
Hearing supplies reception of the wronged party's voiced claim.
Seeing supplies direct witness of acts and limits hidden by competing claims.
Punishment following offense supplies the legal sequence that the cosmic reversal reconfigures as bounded response.
Equivalence and likeness impose proportionality on the response rather than unlimited counterforce.
Transgression beyond a boundary supplies the excess that calls for renewed correction.
Vindication of the wronged gives the reciprocal adjustment its restorative direction.
Leaving punishment and effacing fault prevents the legal model from becoming mechanical retaliation alone.

structural_cues: The deictic-causal transition from ذَٰلِكَ in 22:60 to ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ in 22:61 directly binds the legal scene to the cosmic clauses.
The two يُولِجُ clauses reverse agented objects without deleting either term, matching correction more closely than conquest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equivalence, transgression, redress, pardon, and reciprocal ingress; I supply the arrow from cosmic calibration to bounded justice. A live alternative is that 22:61 proves only divine power and awareness, not a proportional legal pattern.

changed_reading.before: The alternation is simply evidence that God can aid the oppressed.
changed_reading.after: The alternation also images calibrated redress: reciprocal response has a limit, excess is detected, and restoration need not erase pardon.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated divine entry into gardens couples ordinary دخول with a garden-root that carries both night-cover and enclosed orchard, while the same scene contains rivers. The immediate promise of a pleasing entrance for migrants turns the focus's mutual ingress into a pattern of protected passage into a life-bearing interior.

activation_trace.role: An entrance, cave, or concealed refuge makes each temporal phase a shelter into which the other can be brought.
Night supplies protective darkness as well as the temporal term being admitted.
Literal entry into an interior supplies the human-scale counterpart to divine temporal ingress.
The garden root's image of night covering unexpectedly joins the destination to the focus's dark phase.
The tree-screened garden supplies a protected interior rather than an abstract destination.
Running rivers make the entered interior fertile and activate the same root that names day in the focus.
The promised entrance for migrants supplies the immediate passage from displacement into an accepted interior.

structural_cues: 22:14 and 22:23 repeat the same divine-entry, garden, and river sequence.
22:58-59 moves from migration, killing, or death to a divinely effected entrance they will approve immediately before 22:61.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated entry into rivered gardens, the garden-root's night-cover branch, and the migrants' pleasing entrance; I infer that cosmic ingress can analogically guarantee protected passage. The alternative is a looser repetition of divine causation with no shared refuge mechanism.

changed_reading.before: God transfers portions of night and day across a temporal boundary.
changed_reading.after: Divine ingress can also be heard as safeguarded conveyance: a displaced state or person is brought into a covering, fertile interior without being lost.

context_deltas.mechanism: The journeying observers in 22:46 may possess eyes yet lack heart-sight, whereas ears can become routes to understanding. The focus's final pairing therefore contrasts divine perception without occlusion against human exposure to the same alternation without inferential uptake.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as comprehension and response establishes the stronger sense that human observers may fail to reach.
Heart-insight makes بَصِيرٌ a claim of penetrating discernment rather than ocular registration alone.
The heart supplies the interior faculty whose failure can coexist with functioning eyes.
Intellect that restrains ignorance supplies the missing uptake between encountered sign and changed understanding.
The ear's attentive acceptance makes an auditory route to knowledge explicit.
Human hearing can culminate in understanding, sharpening the focus epithet by contrast.
Physical eyes remain available even when the verse says the deeper perceptual failure lies elsewhere.

structural_cues: 22:46 explicitly separates blindness of eyes from blindness of hearts in breasts.
The focus presents the most visible recurring sign and then closes with hearing before seeing, resisting reduction of knowledge to spectacle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies travel, eyes, ears, hearing, reasoning hearts, and inner blindness; I infer that the focus's epithets mark complete uptake of both event and meaning. The alternative is that the attributes denote omniscience without commenting on human interpretation.

changed_reading.before: The day-night cycle is a self-evident visual proof followed by omniscience language.
changed_reading.after: Visibility does not guarantee insight: the closing pair asserts unblocked reception and discernment while exposing the observer's possible heart-blindness.

context_deltas.mechanism: An inventory branch of temporal extension, a branch of one-after-another succession, and the explicit thousand-year day dislodge equal clock units. Mutual ingress can govern phases of radically unequal experienced or measured duration while preserving their ordered relation.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal entry supplies a variable boundary whose movement can redistribute duration.
The night nearest to a day makes temporal adjacency, rather than equal length, the relevant relation.
The bounded daylight interval supplies the ordinary scale that context then stretches.
The branch of a prolonged span activates duration-extension behind the local image of extending a means.
The inventory's alternating succession branch supplies one phase coming after another despite the local negated-failure sense.
Day as an indeterminate duration permits the explicit comparison with a thousand counted years.

structural_cues: 22:47 explicitly makes one day at the Lord equivalent to a thousand years of human counting.
The focus repeats insertion in both directions but supplies no claim that the transferred amounts or experienced spans are equal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal extension, succession, and a thousand-year comparison; I infer that ingress controls elastic phase-duration rather than only sunrise and sunset. A live alternative keeps the thousand-year day eschatological and the focus cycle strictly astronomical.

changed_reading.before: Reciprocal ingress describes equal daily turns on a uniform clock.
changed_reading.after: The relation is ordered but not metrically uniform: divine phase boundaries can compress or extend duration without breaking succession.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water delivered into dormant earth makes it move and green; the focus's day-root simultaneously carries a river channel, and the following sequence gives life, causes death, then gives life. Phase ingress thus becomes a regenerative pulse in which apparent quiescence contains the conditions of renewed activity.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior supplies the transfer by which one phase can alter a dormant substrate or opposing phase.
The river-channel branch gives the daylight term a latent water-bearing capacity.
Dry lifelessness supplies the quiescent phase awaiting ingress.
Delivering water by irrigation or pouring supplies the activating input into the earth.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supplies the first observable state-change after infusion.
Morning as the first of day joins the earth's becoming green directly to the focus's daylight phase.
Fresh green growth supplies the realized output of the hidden water-to-life transition.
Life of earth through rain and growth links the repeated giving of life to the ecological phase mechanism.
Stillness and dormancy supply a reversible middle phase rather than terminal absence.

structural_cues: 22:5 sequences dormant earth, descending water, movement, swelling, and growth.
22:63 follows the focus with water descending from heaven and the earth becoming green at morning.
22:66 gives the reversible sequence life, death, life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hydrological activation, morning greening, and life-death-life; I infer that day-night ingress is the governing pulse connecting those transformations. The alternative is that these are parallel signs of power rather than one regenerative mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Night and day recur as neutral astronomical states.
changed_reading.after: Their mutual entry is a regenerative phase-transfer: dormant states receive an input, become active and fertile, subside, and remain capable of renewed life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ pairing recurs when messengers are selected, then the surah closes with messenger and community as witnesses. Hearing and seeing therefore support not only total perception but the selection, reception, and onward attestation of differentiated carriers.

activation_trace.role: Hearing supplies reception in the proposed relay of message and testimony.
Insight supplies informed discrimination rather than indiscriminate reception.
Choosing a purified select group supplies qualification of the relay's carriers.
Messenger and message supply the carrier relation activated by the repeated divine attributes.
The exact repeated hearing epithet binds selection to reception.
The exact repeated seeing epithet binds selection to discerning oversight.
Presence with observation supplies the downstream witness relation from messenger to community to people.

structural_cues: 22:75 repeats the focus's complete divine hearing-seeing formula immediately after selection of messengers from angels and humans.
22:78 distributes witness roles from messenger to community and from community to humanity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact epithet repetition, selected messengers, and a witness chain; I infer a reception-and-attestation relay that analogically resembles phases carried across a boundary. The alternative is that the repeated attributes independently guarantee wise selection and do not reinterpret the focus's ingress.

changed_reading.before: The closing attributes certify only direct divine awareness of the cosmic cycle.
changed_reading.after: They also activate a relay model: differentiated carriers are selected, received under discerning oversight, and positioned to bear witnessed content onward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from temporal ingress into speech and revelation through the packet's non-dominant ل ج ج branches. It remains anchored in the focus's repeated ingress, mixed darkness, auditory and visual closure, and in 22:52's cast-remove-stabilize sequence. Downstream prose should label it a signal-processing analogy, not claim that 22:61 directly describes prophetic recitation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping of و ل ج activates mixed darkness, mixed voices, and speech moving in the mouth beside سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ.

activation_trace.role: Speech or a morsel turning within the mouth supplies material being repeatedly processed inside a channel.
A confluence of raised, mixed voices supplies signal admixture for the hearing attribute to discriminate.
Mixed and intensified darkness supplies visual admixture for the seeing attribute to penetrate.
Auditory reception supplies one discrimination channel for mixed signals.
Penetrating insight supplies the second channel and the capacity to distinguish valid pattern from obscuring mixture.
Casting something into a field supplies the intrusive input in the context sequence.
Removal followed by replacement supplies selective subtraction rather than mere suppression.
Fastening and perfecting supplies stabilization of what remains after intrusive material is removed.

changed_reading.before: Night and day merely blend while God perceives the blend.
changed_reading.after: The focus can provisionally model governed admixture: inputs enter and mix, while complementary perception distinguishes and stabilizes a valid pattern.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus contains no explicit ritual verb. It remains anchored in the repeated in-and-out branch of يُولِجُ and is activated by the sun and moon prostrating in 22:18 plus repeated circumambulation around the House. Downstream prose should present it only as a formal choreography analogy: yielding, circling, and re-entry, not as a lexical gloss of night and day.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reversed causatives make the two phases repeatedly yield position and re-enter one another.

activation_trace.role: Frequent entry and exit supplies the repeated movement needed for cyclical choreography.
Lowering and yielding supplies the ritual posture assigned by context to cosmic entities.
The sun supplies the luminous body whose yielding generates the visible day-side of the cycle.
The moon and its light supply the nocturnal body participating in the same cosmic submission.
Circling around a center supplies the ritual geometry for repeated departure and return.

changed_reading.before: Alternation is impersonal orbital or temporal motion.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, mutual ingress becomes cosmic ritual choreography: luminous phases yield, circulate, and return under one ordering center.

strongest_changes: The immediate 22:60-61 bridge revises neutral alternation into bounded, evidence-sensitive redress without erasing pardon.
Repeated entry into night-covered, rivered gardens and the migrants' pleasing entrance activate ingress as protected passage.
The earth-water and life-death-life sequences turn phase exchange into a regenerative pulse.
22:46 and the exact epithet repetition in 22:75 separate mere exposure from discerning perception and extend it into a witness relay.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates reversible syntax, a split و ل ج/ل ج ج inventory, the day-root's daylight-river polysemy, and paired auditory-visual attributes. Context repeatedly reuses entry, river, succession, perception, selection, and witness structures, allowing legal, spatial, ecological, epistemic, and exploratory signal or ritual readings to coexist without collapse.
remaining_uncertainties: The legal reading may be a causal proof of power and knowledge rather than a direct analogy of proportional justice.
The hydraulic, signal-filtering, and ritual readings depend on branch activation beyond the most immediate surface senses and require explicit qualification.
The witness-relay reading is strongly activated by exact formula repetition but may not feed back into the night-day mechanism itself.
Temporal elasticity may belong chiefly to eschatological scale in 22:47 rather than ordinary day-night ingress.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Justice is grounded in controlled reciprocal interpenetration.** Repeated reversed `و ل ج B001/B004` supplies entering and repeated passage in and out; `ل ي ل B001` darkness and `ن ه ر B002` day opening with light. Each opposite enters the other without abolishing the cycle. I infer that the measured exchange models God's capacity to reverse dominance while preserve ordered limits, supporting 22:60's matched response. Night-day alternation reads as a cosmic analogue for bounded succession.
2. **Hearing and seeing cover hidden and manifest injury.** `س م ع B001/B003` is hearing and comprehension; `ب ص ر B001/B002` outer and inner sight. These faculties follow the interwoven dark and light. I infer that no wrong is lost merely because it occurs in concealed or visible conditions. The names secure redress through complete perceptual access.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:65 made the alternation model spatially concrete by pairing commanded flow with held descent, while hearing and sight closed both verses as guarantors of care.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Power appears as controlled interpenetration and alternation.** Fixed repeated `يُولِج` activates `و ل ج:B001` (entering into an interior) and `B004` (frequent going in and out), `ٱلَّيْل` activates `ل ي ل:B001` (night and darkness), and `ٱلنَّهَار` activates `ن ه ر:B002` (day opening with light). The exact reversal puts each term inside the other. `22:60` supplied matched response followed by pardon, and `22:62` distinguishes truth from voidness. The packet supplies reciprocal entry; I infer that divine control can transform opposed states through measured alternation rather than one simply destroying the other. The cosmic image gives the prior legal balance a non-identical material analogue.
2. **Hearing and sight keep alternation accountable.** Fixed `سَمِيع` uses `س م ع:B001`, and `بَصِير` uses `ب ص ر:B001` with its `B002` inner-sight scope. I infer from their placement after `22:60` that no injury, response, or overstep disappears inside the cycle. The alternation is governed observation, not blind recurrence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `22:62-63` move from the alternating image to a truth claim and then to subtle water-driven change. These later ayat correct alternation from blind cycle to causally knowledgeable transformation.

findings.text: Gece ile gündüzün birbirine geçirilmesi, ilahî kudreti karşıt zamanları ölçülü biçimde iç içe sokan ve sırayla yöneten güç olarak gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

Bal almakta kullanılan kepçeler ise aynı yer çekirdeğini tanımlamaz; yalnızca kaynakta bu adla verilen ayrı bir sözlük karşılığı olarak tutulmalıdır.

concept_map.definition: İçeri geçmeye yarayan kapı, giriş veya yol ile içine girilip saklanılabilen kuytu yer, mağara ya da hayvan inidir; vadi kıvrımları ve kumdaki yol da bu yer ailesine girer. Bal kepçesi karşılığı, yer çekirdeğinden ayrı bir kaynak varyantıdır.

facets.statement: Bir yere içeri geçmeyi sağlayan kapı, giriş noktası ya da yol adlandırılır.
Yolcuların korunabildiği kuytu yer veya mağara ile hayvanların sığındığı in bu aileye girer.
Arazinin ve vadinin kuytu kesimleri, kıvrımları, köşeleri ve yanları giriş yeri ailesiyle adlandırılır.
Kumdaki belirli bir yol, içeri götüren geçit türü olarak adlandırılır.
Aynı adın bal almakta kullanılan kepçeler için verildiği ayrı bir sözlük karşılığı bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da içine girilerek korunulabilen doğal, kuytu bir yeri adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Mağara anlamında örtüşürler; bu dal giriş ve geçit türlerine yayılırken komşu dal dağdaki doğal oyukla sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yol, kuytu arazi, sığınak, hayvan ini ve vadi kıvrımlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal evin ön avlusunu veya konuta bağlı kapıyı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir yapıya girişte bulunan kapı veya kapıya bağlı alanı anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal içeri geçilen nokta ve kuytu yer ailesidir; komşu dal konutun kapısı ile ona bitişik ön alana bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yapı kapısını, kum yolunu, vadi kıvrımını ve doğal kuytu yerleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal çevrilmiş hayvan barınağına, avcı siperine veya sınırlı bir korunağa odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal hayvanın ya da insanın içine girip korunduğu sınırlı bir yeri adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda giriş ve doğal kuytu yer ilişkisi belirleyicidir; komşu dal ise çevrilmiş, barınma amaçlı kapalı alanı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın girişleri ve kuytu yerleri karşı tarafta bir çıkış bulunmasını gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yer altında ilerleyen ve başka bir çıkışa ulaşan geçit niteliğini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir varlığın içine girip ilerleyebildiği dar bir yol veya geçitle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal herhangi bir giriş, yol ya da sığınak olabilir; komşu dalın ayırıcı özelliği yer altından geçip çıkan tünel yapısıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal içeri girilen kapı, yol, kuytu yer ve sığınağı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal içeri girme olayını ve bir şeyi içeri sokma işlemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal aynı içeri geçiş düzeninin yer ve hareket taraflarını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal geçişin mekansal dayanağını adlandırır; komşu dal ise sınırı aşma hareketini ve ettirgen biçimini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşular değerlendirildi; seçilen beş aday mağara, kapı çevresi, kapalı barınak, çıkışlı tünel ve giriş eylemi üzerinden yer çekirdeğinin sınırlarını en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.branch_image_ar: موضع يلج فيه أو غور يستتر به
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الولاج للباب أو باب خلية النحل، والمولج كمدخل، والولجة موضع أو كهف يستتر فيه، والتولج أو الدولج ككناس الوحش، وغوامض الوادي ومعاطفه ونواحيه، والطريق في الرمل، وما سمي ولجا من مغارف العسل.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الوليجة الاجتماعية، ولا فعل الولوج نفسه إلا من جهة اسم المكان، ولا وجع الوالجة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الولج الطريق في الرمل (maqayis)؛ الولاج الباب والمولج المدخل والتولج الكناس والولاج الغامض من الأرض والوادي (jamhara)؛ الولجة موضع أو كهف تستتر فيه المارة والتولج كناس الوحش (sihah)؛ أولاج الوادي معاطفه وزواياه والولجة مكان من الوادي والولج أيضا مغارف العسل (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız belirli kişi nitelemelerinde sık sık içeri girip dışarı çıkmayı, bir varyantta da işlere girip onlardan çıkmayı anlatır. Bu nedenle dal bağımsız bir giriş anlamı değil, iki yönlü ve yinelenen davranış niteliğidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam, sık girip çıkan kişiyi bildiren sabit nitelemelerle sınırlıdır; tek bir giriş veya tek bir çıkış bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kişi için kullanılan iki parçalı nitelemelere bağlıdır; buradan yalın kök için genel bir sıklık ya da hareket anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kişi nitelemelerinde, bir kimsenin çok sık içeri girip dışarı çıkmasıdır; bir anlatımda kişinin işlere girip sonra onlardan çıkması da bu iki yönlü davranışla ifade edilir.

facets.statement: Kişi çok sık içeri girer ve dışarı çıkar.
Bir varyantta kişi işlerin içine girip sonra onlardan çıkan biri olarak nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, iki parçalı kişi nitelemesinin sık girip çıkmayı bildirdiğinde birleşir; bir anlatım bu davranışı işlere girip çıkma olarak özelleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: sık sık girip çıkan veya işlere girip çıkan kimse
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kişiyi iki yönlü ve yinelenen giriş çıkış davranışıyla niteleyen söz öbekleri için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi, sıklığı ve giriş ile çıkışın birlikte bulunmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir yere tekrar tekrar girip oradan çıkmasını anlatan nitelemede kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yinelenen giriş ve çıkışı kişi niteliği olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin işlerin içine girip ardından onlardan çıktığını bildiren özel varyantta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İşlere katılma ve onlardan ayrılma yönlerini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: çok sık dışarı çıkıp içeri giren adam

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal giriş ile çıkışın birlikte yinelenmesini ve kişide süreklilik gösteren bir nitelik olmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal tek bir içeri giriş olayını veya bir şeyi içeri sokmayı da anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin veya varlığın içeri girme hareketini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yalnız sabit kişi nitelemesinde sık ve iki yönlü hareketi bildirir; komşu dalın çekirdeği tek başına giriş eylemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal işlere girmeye ek olarak onlardan çıkmayı, sıklığı ve kişi niteliğini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız bir işe girme eylemini bildirir ve çıkış ya da tekrar koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişinin bir işin içine katılması anlamında örtüşebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İş bağlamında yakınlaşırlar; ancak bu dal giriş ve çıkışın eşleştiği kalıcı bir kişi niteliğidir, komşu dal tek yönlü eylemdir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal çıkıştan sonra yeniden giriş yönünü, tekrarı ve kişi nitelemesini de içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir yerden başka yere hareket etme veya çıkıp yol alma olayına odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir kişinin bulunduğu yerden dışarı çıkması yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal çıkış ve yolculuk yönündedir; bu dal çıkışı girişle eşleyip sık yinelenen bir davranış olarak sunar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal giriş ve çıkışın sık tekrarlanmasını yalnız kişi nitelemesinde bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ilerleme, yaşa veya döneme girme ve yol alma gibi çok çeşitli tek yönlü süreçleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir alana veya duruma girme hareketi bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çift yönlü tekrar ve kişi niteliğiyle sınırlıdır; komşu dal girişten sonra ilerleyen daha geniş süreçleri anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; yayımlanan dört karşılaştırma yalın giriş, işe girme, çıkıp gitme ve içeri ilerleme sınırlarını açıklar, diğer adaylar yalnız biçimsel sıklık veya uzak hareket çağrışımı taşır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رجل خرجة ولجة أو خراج ولاج: الكثير الخروج والدخول أو الداخل في الأمور والخارج منها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الدخول المفرد، ولا الوليجة بمعنى البطانة، ولا مواضع الدخول.
branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل خرجة ولجة كثير الخروج والولوج (maqayis)؛ رجل خراج ولاج للذي يدخل في الأمور ويخرج منها (jamhara)؛ رجل خرجة ولجة كثير الخروج والدخول (sihah)؛ رجل خرجة ولجة كثير الخروج والولوج (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin bir bölümü ağrıyı insanın iç boşluğuna işleyen bir rahatsızlık olarak açıkça tanımlar, diğer bölümü ise yalnız insanı tutan ağrı der. Bu nedenle içe işleme görüntüsü dalı iyi temsil eder, fakat her kullanımda kesin bir organ veya yalnız karın bölgesi varsayılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, insanı tutan ve özellikle iç boşluğa işlediği düşünülen ağrı adıdır; genel hastalık, boğaz ağrısı veya yaralanma anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, iki ad biçiminin doğrudan ağrı anlamını verir; komşu hastalık adlarından veya söz öbeklerinden ek bir organ ve belirti koşulu alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanı tutan, özellikle bedenin iç boşluğuna işlediği düşünülen bir ağrıdır. Kaynak ifadesi kesin bir organı her durumda belirtmez.

facets.statement: Ağrı insanı tutar ve ona rahatsızlık verir.
Ağrı bedenin iç boşluğuna giren veya içeri işleyen bir ağrı olarak tasarlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bunun insanı tutan bir ağrı adı olduğunda birleşir; daha ayrıntılı açıklama ağrının insanın iç boşluğuna işlediğini belirtir.

concept_gloss.text: insanı tutan, iç boşluğa işleyen ağrı
concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli bir organı zorunlu kılmadan, insanı tutan ve bedene içten işlediği düşünülen ağrı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ağrı olmasını, insanı tutmasını ve iç boşluğa işleme niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ağrının bedenin iç boşluğuna doğru girdiğinin düşünüldüğü açıklamada kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ağrının iç boşluğa doğru işleme görüntüsünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ağrının yeri ayrıca belirtilmeden yalnız kişiyi etkilediği genel açıklamada kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ağrının kişiyi etkileyip tutmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal özellikle ağrıyı adlandırır ve onu iç boşluğa işleyen bir duyum olarak sunar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal iç organları tutan daha genel bir hastalık adı ve kişiyi bütünüyle kaplayan rahatsızlık görüntüsü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal insanın iç boşluğunu etkileyen bir rahatsızlığı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal ağrı türüdür; komşu dal ağrıdan daha geniş bir hastalık kavramı taşır ve kişiyi kaplama görüntüsüyle açıklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal iç boşluğa işleme görüntüsünü taşır ve her kullanımda karnı açıkça belirtmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal rahatsızlığın yerini doğrudan karın olarak sınırlar ve onu hastalık olarak da adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bedenin iç kısmında duyulan ve kişiyi tutan ağrıyı anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal karın bölgesine bağlıdır; bu dalın kanıtı daha geniş bir iç boşluk ve içe işleme tasarımına izin verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ağrının iç boşluğa girip işlemesi biçimindeki açıklamayı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız karındaki belirli bir ağrının özel adı olarak verilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal insanın beden içindeki ağrısını, özellikle karın çevresinde yorumlanabilecek bir rahatsızlığı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal belirli bir karın ağrısı adıyla sınırlıdır; bu dal ise içeri işleyen ağrı görüntüsüyle tanımlanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal insanı tutan belirli bir ağrı adını ve iç boşluğa işleme niteliğini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hastalık, ağrıdan yakınma, hasta kişi ve ağrıyan organ gibi daha geniş bir söz alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bedensel rahatsızlık ve ağrı alanında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli bir ağrı türüdür; komşu dal hastalık ve yakınma süreçlerini de içeren geniş bir alandır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yeri kesinleşmemiş biçimde iç boşluğa işleyen ağrıyı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız boğazda bulunan ağrıyı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bedende duyulan bir ağrı türünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortaklık yalnız ağrı alanındadır; komşu dal boğaza özgüdür, bu dal ise genel iç boşluk ve içe işleme ilişkisine dayanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar değerlendirildi; yayımlanan karşılaştırmalar iç organ rahatsızlığı, karın ağrısı, genel hastalık ve boğaz ağrısı sınırlarını gösterir, diğerleri farklı organlara veya yaralanma süreçlerine daha uzaktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin malını hayattayken çocuklarından bazılarına ayırmasını ve bunun duyulmasıyla başkalarının istemekten vazgeçmesini anlatan özel bir mal tasarrufunu açıkça verir. Anlam, genel verme veya miras bırakma değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam, malın yaşam sırasında bazı çocuklara ayrıldığı ve başkalarının talebini kesme sonucu taşıyan özel ifadeyle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız mal, kişinin yaşamı ve çocuklarından bazılarıyla kurulan özel söz öbeğine bağlıdır; yalın biçime genel verme, bağışlama veya miras anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin malını hayattayken çocuklarından bazılarına ayırmasıdır; bu tasarrufun duyulması, başkalarının o malı istemekten vazgeçmesi sonucunu doğurur.

facets.statement: Kişi malını yaşamı sürerken çocuklarından bazılarına ayırır.
Tasarrufun duyulmasıyla başka insanlar bu malı istemekten vazgeçer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu özel mal tasarrufu, malın kişi hayattayken çocuklarından bazılarına ayrılmasını ve haber yayıldığında başkalarının talebinin kesilmesini birlikte anlatır.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynaklı kullanım, yaşam sırasında çocuğa mal ayırma ile başkalarının istemekten vazgeçmesi sonucunu birlikte verir.

concept_gloss.text: malı hayattayken bazı çocuklarına ayırıp başkalarının istemesini önleme
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız malın yaşam sırasında bazı çocuklara ayrıldığı ve dış taleplerin kesildiği özel tasarruf için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Malı, yaşam sırasındaki ayırmayı, çocuklardan bazılarını ve talebi önleme sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mal sahibinin ölümünden önce malını çocuklarının yalnız bir bölümüne tahsis ettiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaşam sırasındaki mal ayırmayı ve çocuklardan bazılarının seçilmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tasarrufun duyulmasıyla diğer insanların mal talebinden vazgeçmesi sonucunu açıklamak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Mal ayırma ile başkalarının talebinin kesilmesi arasındaki sonucu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: malını hayattayken çocuklarından bazılarına ayırıp insanların istemekten vazgeçmesini sağlamak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yaşam zamanını, çocuklardan bazılarının seçilmesini ve başkalarının talebini kesme sonucunu gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir kişiye herhangi bir şeyi verme ve mülkiyet kazandırma anlamını genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: özel mal ayırma ve genel verme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir malın başka bir kişinin kullanımına veya mülkiyetine geçirilmesi bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal aile içindeki özel ve amaçlı tasarrufa bağlıdır; komşu dal alıcı, zaman ve amaç bakımından böyle bir sınırlama taşımaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bazı çocuklara ayrılan malı ve başkalarının istemesini önleme sonucunu içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ev, arazi veya hayvanın bir kişinin yaşam süresine bağlanarak kullandırılması ve geri dönüş koşullarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da mal sahibinin yaşamla bağlantılı özel bir tahsis yapmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal tahsisi yapanın yaşamında çocuğa mal ayırmadır; komşu dal kullanım süresini taraflardan birinin ömrüne bağlayan ayrı bir işlemdir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal mal sahibinin hayattayken yaptığı seçici bir ayırma işlemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal malın ölümden sonra soy veya başka bir hukuki sebeple mirasçıya geçmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: sağlığında ayırma ve ölümden sonra miras
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal aile içinde malın önceki sahibinden başka bir kişiye geçmesiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Temel ayrım zamandır ve işlemdir: bu dal yaşam sırasında iradi ayırmadır, komşu dal ölüm sonrasında gerçekleşen miras geçişidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kişinin mal üzerinde hayattayken yaptığı özel tasarrufu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişinin ölümünden sonra geride kalan mal varlığını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yaşarken ayrılan mal ve geride kalan mal
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı kişinin mal varlığının aileye kalması senaryosunda ilişkilendirilebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Anlamsal çekirdekleri farklıdır: biri yaşam sırasındaki işlem, diğeri ölümden sonra geride bulunan maldır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal malı çocuklardan bazılarına ayırarak onlara yöneltir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal malı tutma, engelleme, geri alma veya babanın çocuğunun malına dönmesi işlemlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: mala yön verme ve malı geri tutma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ebeveyn ile çocuk arasında mal üzerinde özel bir tasarruf içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çocuğa doğru bir ayırmadır; komşu dal malı elde tutma veya çocuktan geri alma yönünde ters bir işlem de içerebilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilenler genel verme, ömre bağlı tahsis, miras geçişi, geride kalan mal ve geri tutma üzerinden özel yaşam içi tasarrufun sınırını en iyi açıklar.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مطلق الإدخال، ولا الوليجة للبطانة، ولا المواضع الداخلة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: ولج فلان ماله توليجا إذا جعله في حياته لبعض ولده (tahdhib)

root_profile.summary: Kökün anlam örgüsü içeri girme çekirdeğinden, dışarıdan iç çevreye alınmış unsur ve giriş yeri adlarına; sık girip çıkan kişi, içe işleyen ağrı ve yaşam sırasında yapılan özel mal tasarrufuna uzanan çok dallı bir yapı gösterir.
